long_description.title: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of the world’s hardest-rockin’ guitar brand
long_description.body:
Kramer is turning 50, so naturally, we’re cranking things up to 11! In honor of five decades of boundary-pushing tone and iconic design, we’re unleashing a special limited-edition series of some of our most popular models, each finished in glossy metallic Anniversary Gold. These guitars defined an era and continue to inspire generations of players. Each model is limited to this anniversary year, making them a must-have for collectors and players alike. 

The Kramer 50th Anniversary Baretta honors Kramer’s first Golden Age and is a tribute to one of the most iconic and original guitar designs in rock. This guitar is ideal for today’s guitarists who are seeking a fast-playing design that can keep up with their technical virtuosity and deliver the goods for not only 80s metal but today’s modern rock and heavy genres. It features a maple body with forearm and rear tummy contours, making it comfortable to play for hours. The deep double cutaways on the body let you hit the high notes with ease. The satin-finished bolt-on three-piece maple neck has a 25.5” scale length, an ebony fretboard, and fast-playing Kramer Thin profile, while the 22 jumbo frets facilitate easy string bends and left-hand vibrato. The hockey stick headstock is outfitted with a Floyd Rose® R2 locking nut, black mini die-cast tuners, a black string retaining bar, and a matching black wrench holder on the rear so you’ll always have the tools you need on hand for a quick adjustment or string change. The headstock is also finished in Anniversary Gold to match the body. The Floyd Rose 1000 Series tremolo delivers unmatched tuning stability, regardless of how hard or often you work the whammy bar. 

In the electronics department, the 50th Anniversary Baretta keeps it simple, with a single uncovered Kramer Eruption PRO™ humbucker with zebra bobbins wired to a single volume control. The volume control includes a built-in push/pull series/parallel switch for two classic tones from the single pickup, yielding a brighter tone in parallel mode. When running in series, it delivers the full-shred humbucker™ tone you crave and the scorching-hot output you need to drive your amp—and your fans—into a frenzy. The 50th Anniversary Baretta comes packed in a Kramer premium gig bag, so it’s ready to join you on all of your musical adventures. This is more than a guitar—it is a collector’s dream with premium components and a piece of rock history, and will only be available during this anniversary year. Don’t miss your chance to own a legend, reborn for Kramer’s 50th Anniversary.
